entries.title: I Samuel 19:1
segments: Envy indulged often leads to murder, and many are in heart guilty of this sin wo are prevented from outwardly ocmmitting it.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:3
segments: In the field; where Jonathan expected his father would walk.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:4
segments: Real love will seek the good of the object beloved, and if need be, perform labors, make sacrifices, and meet dangers to promote it.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:6
segments: Sound reason and kind persuasion may for a time overcome passion; but without a change of heart, when depravity is restrained in one direction it will break out in another.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:10
segments: When one is given up to the power of evil, not only engagements but solemn oaths will be disregarded, and malignant passions will overcome all restraint.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:17
segments: Those who hate others, and treat them as enemies, are apt to feel that others hate them and are their enemies.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:18
segments: Naioth; a place in Benjamin, near to Ramah.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:20
segments: The hearts of all are in the hands of the Lord, and he can turn them whithersoever he will.  No devices will succeed against those whom he designs to bless, and no evils will come upon them which he will not overrule for their good.

entries.title: I Samuel 19:24
segments:
His clothes; his outer garments. 
 
  Naked; without his upper garments.
